title: PC third-party library analysis report
description: Final report produced by the pc-lib-analyzer agent. The languages/code_metrics/tests blocks come verbatim from the code-metrics script (deterministic); every other block is reasoned by the model via its skill.

kind.description: model: 被分析对象的性质。推荐取值（开放，可扩并记入 meta.observations）：library（被 API 调用的三方库）/ application（终端用户启动运行的应用，如桌面/CLI）/ framework / tool / cli / service / plugin / other。缺省/旧报告按 library 处理。决定 dim-9 鸿蒙口径：library→模型A/B（重编+链接/桥接），application→模型C（整包应用打包并启动）。

package_name.description: model: distribution/package name from the manifest (PyPI/npm/Maven artifact/crate name), may differ from the repo dir name. Used to link this library into other libraries' dependency trees. Null if none/uncertain.

ecosystem.description: 库的核心语言生态，由模型根据 manifest 与主语言判断。取值：python / java / nodejs / cpp / rust / go / dotnet / other

bindings.description: model: 该库在核心生态之外对外提供绑定/包装的语言生态（如 C++ 核心 + Python/Java/C# 绑定 → [python, java, dotnet]）。无则 []。用于多语言库的生态展示。

function_summary.description: Dimension 1 — MODEL (skill: function-summary). All prose fields here (summary, category name/description, domain, target_users) and library.one_liner are written in Simplified Chinese (简体中文).

summary.description: 2-4 sentences: what it does, for whom.

items.description: per-language totals; production/test/example split the same files by category

platform_adaptation.description: 各平台被编译宏(#ifdef _WIN32/__APPLE__/__linux__…)正向包裹的生产代码量（机械计数，C/C++/ObjC；#ifndef/!defined 不计）。作为鸿蒙适配复杂度信号之一供 dim-9 参考。

code.description: 该平台守卫块内代码行

tests.description: Dimension 4 — SCRIPT counts; model may refine framework/notes.

evidence.description: what the call is based on

ecosystem.description: LANGUAGE ecosystem only: cpp/c/python/java/nodejs/rust/go/dotnet/other. Use 'other' for non-language deps (data files, generic tools); do NOT put role values like 'tool'/'data' here — a dependency's build-tool nature belongs in scope:build.

acquisition.description: OPEN vocabulary — how the build OBTAINS this dependency. Recommended values: system (find_package/expected pre-installed), vendored (source copied into the tree), fetchcontent (CMake FetchContent), download_build (ExternalProject/custom download-source-and-build), submodule (git submodule), package_manager (vcpkg/conan/pip/npm/maven), prebuilt_binary (binary shipped in repo). If none fits, coin a concise lowercase token (e.g. conda, apt, cpm, git_subtree, runtime_download) AND record it in meta.observations. Also set the closed `locality` field accordingly.

locality.description: STABLE axis (model-set): local=already in repo (vendored/prebuilt); remote=pulled from outside (fetchcontent/download/submodule/registry); system=expected pre-installed via find_package; runtime=loaded at runtime; unknown

source.description: model: WHERE it is obtained from — download URL / registry / 'system (find_package, must be pre-installed)' / in-tree path, 简体中文

declared_in.description: model: repo file(s) that declare how this dependency is integrated, e.g. the CMakeLists.txt with find_package/FetchContent_Declare/ExternalProject_Add/target_link_libraries, a .gitmodules entry, or a requirements/manifest line

used_symbols.description: model (best-effort, codegraph/grep): the dependency's public symbols / APIs THIS library actually calls (e.g. cairo_create, BIO_new, numpy.ndarray). Consumed by dim-9 bottom-up rollup: a child's un-adaptable API only blocks this (parent) library if it appears here. Omit/empty for system deps or when usage can't be pinned down (rollup then falls back to dependency scope).

harmony_adapted.description: SCRIPT-stamped (scripts/harmony_adapted.js): true if this package already has an official HarmonyOS PC build in the OpenHarmony PC mirror (an *-ohos_*.whl etc.). Consumed by dim 9 (already-adapted dep ⇒ not a blocker). Do NOT set by hand.

harmony_adapted_source.description: SCRIPT-stamped: which OpenHarmony PC mirror provides the adapted build.

type.description: API family, e.g. win32, posix, cpp_stl, python_stdlib, java_std, node_core, syscall, ctypes_ffi, jni, opengl, directx, arch_simd

category.description: 按可移植性分类。standard=语言标准库/运行时,到处可用(C++ STL、Python stdlib、JDK标准包、Node内置); platform=某OS专有,换平台即没有(Win32 与 POSIX-only 如 mmap/fork/epoll/<unistd.h> 都属此,再用 platform 字段标 windows/posix/macos); system=内核/系统调用层(裸 syscall、ioctl、/proc、/sys、注册表、WMI、设备); ffi=互操作桥(ctypes/cffi/JNI/N-API); hardware=GPU/SIMD/加速器

platform.description: 该组 API 所属平台；portable=跨平台(标准库)

apis.description: 逐个具体 API（代表性，非穷举）

name.description: 单个具体 API/符号名（如 mmap、CreateFileMapping、std::filesystem）。不要把多个调用并进一个 name（如 'mmap / munmap'），否则 count 失去意义

purpose.description: 中文：该 API 的作用

count.description: 调用次数/出现次数（代表性近似，grep -c 或 codegraph callers）

evidence.description: 调用位置 file:line（代表性 1-3 处）

conditional.description: 是否被 #ifdef / 平台条件守卫

symbols.description: deprecated: 旧版扁平符号列表，向后兼容；新输出请用 apis

evidence.description: group-level files / includes (optional; prefer per-api evidence)

dynamic_libraries.description: Libraries loaded at RUNTIME via dynamic loading (not declared in package manifests). Model resolves the loaded library name and infers its purpose.

name.description: loaded library name, e.g. 'libssl.so', 'kernel32.dll', 'libcudart' (keep as written; '<dynamic>' if computed at runtime)

mechanism.description: how it is loaded: dlopen / LoadLibrary / ctypes.CDLL / ctypes.WinDLL / cffi.dlopen / JNI System.loadLibrary / node N-API addon

acquisition.description: OPEN vocab — HOW the loaded lib is obtained: self_build (built from THIS repo, e.g. a CFFI/JNI/SWIG wrapper), system (external/OS-provided), bundled (shipped in repo), third_party, unknown

source.description: 中文：是什么库 / 出处（身份与来源），如「本仓 MinimalLib 的 CFFI 构建产物」「外部专有 DLL，需 COMBICHEM_ROOT 提供」

description.description: model-inferred purpose of the loaded library, 简体中文

optional.description: true if load failure is handled gracefully (feature is optional)

runtime_surface.description: Dimension 8a — MODEL (skill: runtime-environment). What the code reaches for in the HOST environment at runtime (beyond linked libraries). Descriptive only. Each array uses [] when empty; prose in 简体中文.

summary.description: 中文：运行时对宿主环境依赖的概述

network.description: sockets / HTTP clients / bound ports / hard-coded hosts

filesystem.description: config/data files, temp dirs, absolute paths read/written at runtime

services.description: 外部服务/守护进程的集成（多见于应用）：attach 其他 JVM、JMX、jstatd、数据库/消息队列/IPC 等。[] when none

build_env.description: Dimension 8b — MODEL (skill: runtime-environment). Toolchain / language-standard requirements and the supported OS/arch matrix. Descriptive only; prose in 简体中文.

runtime_version.description: 中文：运行时/解释器版本要求

platforms.description: supported OS/arch matrix inferred from #ifdef / CI / wheels / manifests

name.description: 启动器脚本/可执行/main 类/控制台脚本名，如 launcher/visualvm、visualvm.exe、org.x.Main

entry_points.description: 应用如何被启动（启动器脚本、原生 launcher、main 类、框架托管启动、console_scripts）。库通常为 []

packaging.description: 中文：如何构建/打包/分发给终端用户——installer / zip / AppImage / 容器镜像 / 应用商店包 / 无（库）；含是否捆绑运行时（JRE/Node）。

harmony_adaptation.description: Dimension 9 — MODEL (skill: harmony-adaptation). SYNTHESIS dimension: feasibility / difficulty / path of porting the library to HarmonyOS NEXT PC (self-kernel, ArkTS app layer, OHOS NDK native layer, Node-API bridge — NO Linux ABI). Derived by reasoning over the already-filled native_api / runtime_surface / dependencies / build_env / library blocks, reusing their evidence. Prose in 简体中文.

target.description: 中文/英文：评估所针对的鸿蒙平台口径（HarmonyOS NEXT PC 等）

feasibility.description: 闭轴：整体可行性。须与 porting_class 确定性自洽（no_adaptation→feasible；recompile_only/needs_adaptation_full→feasible_with_effort；needs_adaptation_partial→hard；infeasible→infeasible）。server 会据 porting_class 校验/补全。

porting_class.description: ★唯一权威机器轴（依赖拓扑图 + 难度派生用）。no_adaptation=纯脚本跑在已移植运行时/无原生工作；recompile_only=C/C++ 仅需 OHOS NDK 重编、无平台 API/平台差异；needs_adaptation_full=需改造但用到的功能全部能适配/有替代(unadaptable_apis 为空)；needs_adaptation_partial=部分功能因平台/硬件 API 无法适配(见 unadaptable_apis)但核心仍可用；infeasible=核心不可适配/依赖特定硬件无解。须与 feasibility/recommended_path 自洽。旧值 needs_adaptation 保留兼容，等同 needs_adaptation_partial 档。

effort.description: 工作量与难度。模型只估 person_days（区间）；level 由 server 按固定 rubric 从 (porting_class 下限 × person_days 上界分桶) 取高确定性派生——模型无需自填、填了也以派生为准。这样难度与 porting_class 自洽且 person_days 可跨依赖树数值聚合。

person_days.description: ★模型估的工作量人-天区间 [min,max]，区间宽度表达不确定性。锚点：极低0–2 / 低2–5 / 中5–15 / 高15–40 / 极高40+。可跨依赖树累加（rollup）。

level.description: 闭轴：难度等级（server 派生）。展示：very_low=极低 low=低 medium=中 high=高 very_high=极高。

confidence.description: ★闭轴：本评估的置信度。存在 required 且 target_status=unknown 的 target_assumptions 时至多 medium；沿依赖树取 min 传播（rollupConfidence）。

id.description: 稳定 id，形如 ua:culaunch；供 blockers.manifests_as 引用、跨树去重。

api.description: 该库用到的、HarmonyOS 无对应实现/无法适配的底层 API（平台/系统/硬件 API 名，如 ioctl、CreateFileW、cuLaunchKernel）

public_entry.description: 本库对外暴露、会路由到该不支持 API 的公共函数/符号（父库实际调用的那一层，如 cairo_create）。父库的 dependencies[].used_symbols 与此求交决定是否阻塞父——故尽量填准。

reason.description: 中文：为何无法适配（平台专有/硬件依赖/无替代等）

blocking_native_api.description: 对应 native_api 里的具体调用（可与 api 相同；标明阻碍根源）

category.description: 复用 native_api 分类口径

evidence.description: 复用 native_api 的调用点 file:line

unadaptable_apis.description: API 粒度的不可适配清单（dim-9 自底向上综合用：子库的此清单与父库 used_symbols 求交，命中才阻塞父）。porting_class 须自洽：非空且核心可用→needs_adaptation_partial。

id.description: 稳定 id，形如 ta:swing；供 blockers/unadaptable_apis 的 caused_by 引用。

capability.description: 结论所依赖的鸿蒙 PC 目标能力（如 headful Swing/AWT、跨进程 attach、jdk.internal.jvmstat 开放、传统桌面应用交付）

required.description: 该能力是否为本项目可移植的必需前提

target_status.description: 目标平台对该能力的支持状态，取自 references/harmony-pc-capabilities.md

impact.description: 中文：该目标事实如何影响结论（如「不支持则整体不可运行」）

source.description: 事实来源，通常 references/harmony-pc-capabilities.md 的对应条目

target_assumptions.description: 结论所依赖的目标平台能力假设（来自 references/harmony-pc-capabilities.md 的匹配）。target_status=unknown 的项表示结论依赖未核实事实——应同时下调 meta.confidence_overall 并在 notes 说明，不得据 unknown 臆断为可行。库通常为空或仅运行时一条。

recommended_path.description: 开放词：推荐适配路径，如 recompile_napi / cross_compile / arkts_rewrite / wrap_ffi / find_alternative / abandon

summary.description: 中文：总体判断与为何选这条路径

id.description: 稳定 id，形如 bk:gpu；供跨树去重/引用。

adaptability.description: ★闭轴：该阻碍能否适配——adaptable=有 @ohos 替代/重编可解；partial=部分可解；unadaptable=无解(此类应同时进 unadaptable_apis)。derivePortingClass 据此结构化判分级，不再靠 category 开放词正则。

category.description: 开放词：如 subprocess_unavailable / win32_api / sysfs_procfs / registry_wmi / node_core_module / ffi_bridge / native_dependency / toolchain

source_dimension.description: 来源维度：native_api / runtime_surface / dependencies / build_env / library

caused_by.description: 回指根因 target_assumptions[].id（可空）——同一事实只在主清单登记完整内容，此处仅引用，避免重复计入难度。

manifests_as.description: 若该阻碍体现为具体不可适配 API，引用 unadaptable_apis[].id（可空）。

blockers.description: 从前序维度推导的移植阻碍点（结果层）。同一事实只在主清单登记一次：target 事实→target_assumptions、无法适配的具体 API→unadaptable_apis、阻碍点→此处，其余清单用 id 引用。

aspect.description: 中文：可平滑移植的方面

key_tasks.description: 中文：落地推荐路径的关键工作项

notes.description: 中文：假设、局限、置信度补充

observations.description: Self-capture for skill feedback (反哺): novel values the model coined, gaps in the recommended taxonomy, or classification ambiguities it hit. Reviewed in the panel's 模型观察 page and used to improve skills over time.

dimension.description: which dimension/skill, e.g. dependencies, native_api, license

field.description: the field the observation is about, e.g. acquisition, type

value.description: the coined value or short tag

rationale.description: 中文：为什么这样判断 / 现有取值为何不够
